what: Several cards and tables fly in from random positions (sideways ±300px, vertical ±50px) and angles (±20°) with a 1s circ.out and stack in place. Each is .1s later than the last and appears during the first .2s of flight. The accompanying props (after) rise from 100px below at 1 + .2n seconds afterward. The scattered positions differ each time it opens.

options.x: Max distance scattering sideways (px), default 300 — the reference ticket stack uses 500 (phone 0)
options.y: Max up-down distance (px), default 50 — table dummy 300
options.fade: Appearance duration (sec), default 0.2 — About tags use half of dur

from.where: shared.js flyIn (social card strip) · index.js movie (table pile x500 y300) · about tag (rotationSlide x400 y100 rot10)
